text:
sara: Heads-up — multiple support tickets from customers in us-west-2 reporting intermittent 502/504s and elevated tail latency hitting hosted inference. Tickets started ~11:02 PDT. Appears to spike around cross-AZ traffic.

jamal: seeing spikes in gateway 5xxs on the hosted-api LB. Alert channel lit up for p50/p95 latency. Noticed increase in upstream resets in pod logs: 
```
upstream reset: connection reset by peer
status=502 path=/v1/generate model=redwood-2
```

maria-support: Customer AcmeHealth (enterprise) called — their production traffic saw sustained 502s for ~7m, then recovery. They attached a curl example: 
```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' 
https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"..."}'
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (10.20.30.40) port 443 (#0)
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/2
< HTTP/2 502
< content-type: application/json
< {"error":"upstream error"}
```

kevin-netops: running traceroutes now between us-west-2b -> us-west-2c worker pool. Early signs of micro packet-loss and latency spikes on a provider egress link. BGP session with transit-1 shows flaps matching timestamps.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1375 | severity: high | affected: hosted inference (us-west-2) | assigned: kevin-netops, jamal, maria-support

kevin-netops: pasted traceroute/snippets: 
```
traceroute to gw.provider.example (203.0.113.5), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.456 ms 0.345 ms 0.320 ms
 6  provider-peering-1  12.3 ms  12.8 ms  *
 7  provider-core-3  45.1 ms  120.9 ms  46.2 ms
 8  distant-hop  *  *  *  
```
Notes: intermittent * on middle hops and single-digit packet loss in pings. Also seeing BGP AS path change: 64512 -> 64513 -> 64512 around the time of errors.

jamal: logs from API gateway (nginx-like edge): 
```
2026-03-09T18:12:04Z error upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream
2026-03-09T18:12:04Z 502 "GET /v1/generate" host: api.redwood.ai upstream: "http://10.4.7.22:8080/"
```

maria-support: also seeing auth failures in some customer repros — token exchange timed out leading to 401s in the console followed by retries that then surface 502s. Might be reactive due to network timeouts causing session truncation. Customers report inconsistent behavior across regions — only us-west-2 hit.

sara: Is the problem strictly intra-region (cross-AZ) or provider egress? Kevin?

kevin-netops: both. Core issue: provider egress experiencing microbursts causing packet loss. That triggers our cross-zone retries and some edge connections end up with truncated frames leading to gateway resets. Also seeing a handful of routes briefly preferring a longer AS path (provider failover).

ingest-bot: Telemetry: prefix 203.0.113.0/24 saw 1.8% packet loss at 18:11:30-18:18:00 and RTT > 200ms spikes.

jamal: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) temporarily route customer ingress for hosted-api in us-west-2 away from the affected provider (if we have alternate peering) 2) increase upstreamkeepalive / proxy_read_timeout to absorb transient loss 3) enable auto-failover to compatible model variant in eu-west-1 for enterprise customers as fallback. Thoughts?

kevin-netops: We have alternate transit (transit-2) — can initiate traffic shift for the affected AZs. Doing a controlled failover to transit-2 for us-west-2c (low blast radius) now.

sara: Jamal, increase proxy timeouts and ramp upstream retries to reduce immediate 502s. Be careful—don't amplify retry storms. Set max attempts=2 and backoff jitter. Maria, notify top-tier customers with suggested temporary workaround: pin region to another region or enable cross-region fallback in Console.

maria-support: I’ll message AcmeHealth and a couple more. Telling them we’re failing over transit and to expect improved connectivity in ~5–10m. Will offer to route their traffic to eu-west-1 if they prefer immediate stability.

kevin-netops: Failover started 18:20Z. Confirming BGP next-hops changed. Monitoring ping loss to provider egress: loss dropped to ~0.1% after reroute.

jamal: Applied proxy config change at 18:23Z: 
```yaml
proxy_read_timeout: 60s
upstream_retries: 2
retry_backoff: 50ms
```
Edge metrics show 502 rate declining. p95 latency trending down.

maria-support: Customers reporting immediate improvement. AcmeHealth confirms 502s dropped to baseline. Marking their ticket as informed; keeping open for 24h monitoring.

sara: Postmortem action items: 
- kevin: coordinate with transit-1 for root cause and ask for SLA credit if applicable.
- eng-runtime: evaluate safer defaults for proxy timeouts and bounded retry policies during transient network loss.
- platform: test and document regional fallback flows in Console for enterprise users.
- support: compile list of impacted customers and outreach log.

kevin-netops: opening a follow-up with transit-1 (case T-7581). Collected pcap snippets and BGP logs. Will share once we have provider analysis.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1375 updated: status => mitigated | mitigation: transit failover + proxy tuning | time to mitigate: ~12m | severity => elevated -> monitoring

maria-support: Marking affected customers and adding notes for billing — no evidence of idempotent token leaks but flagging for potential SLO/Billing credits requests.

sara: Thanks all. Keep this thread for the postmortem notes; we'll draft the incident report tomorrow and include timeline + provider RCA when received. :white_check_mark:
